title: Letamini in Domino (Selectissimarum mutetarum) (Richafort)
desc: Jean Richafort, Letamini in Domino (Selectissimarum mutetarum). 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Selectissimarum mutetarum. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
